_comment: Reusable knowledge base of AEM WCM Core Component -> proposed EDS block mappings, with functional requirements, acceptance criteria and complexity. Keyed by the primary detection signal (a cmp-* class or a custom-widget key). build-catalog.js merges discovered components with these entries; unknown components get auto-stubs flagged needsReview:true for the agent to complete. Add new entries here as new component types are encountered so future runs improve.

cmp-homepageHero.name: Homepage Hero
cmp-homepageHero.complexityReason: Marketing hero with headline, eyebrow, supporting copy, media and CTA buttons; largely static but responsive with layered media.
functional: Displays a large headline, eyebrow, supporting text and one or more CTA buttons over/with media.
CTAs link to key conversion pages (e.g. contact/get-started).
acceptance: Hero renders headline, copy and CTA(s).
Each CTA navigates to its target.
Hero is responsive across breakpoints.
verify: Confirm the CTA links resolve; check responsive layout.

cmp-about-hero.name: About Hero
cmp-about-hero.complexityReason: Static section hero (heading + copy + imagery) introducing the About page.
functional: Heading + narrative copy + supporting imagery introducing the page.
acceptance: Renders heading, copy and imagery.

cmp-approach-hero.name: Approach Hero (stat hero)
cmp-approach-hero.complexityReason: Section hero highlighting a headline plus a large stat/number and imagery.
functional: Heading, supporting copy and a prominent stat/figure with imagery.
acceptance: Renders heading, stat and imagery.

cmp-careers-hero.name: Careers Hero
cmp-careers-hero.complexityReason: Section hero for careers with heading, copy, imagery and CTA(s) (e.g. explore jobs).
functional: Heading + copy + imagery + CTA button(s) linking to jobs/apply.
acceptance: Renders heading and imagery; CTA(s) navigate to jobs/apply.
verify: Confirm CTA links resolve (may be external ATS).

cmp-contact-hero.name: Contact Hero + Form
cmp-contact-hero.complexityReason: Contact page hero containing a multi-field lead form (13 inputs observed) plus an embedded video and testimonial; requires form handling, validation and a submit endpoint. On EDS this is a form block wired to a form service.
functional: Heading + intro copy.
Multi-field contact/lead form (name, email, company, message, etc.).
Client-side validation + submit to a form endpoint.
Includes an embedded video and a testimonial/quote.
Links to LinkedIn and jobs.
acceptance: The form renders all fields and validates required inputs.
Submitting with valid data posts to the endpoint and shows a success state.
Submitting with invalid data shows validation errors.
The embedded video plays.
verify: Inspect the form fields and submit action.
Attempt an invalid submit to observe validation; observe success behavior.
Confirm the video embed provider/player.

cmp-insight-hero.name: Insights Hero (featured)
cmp-insight-hero.complexityReason: Featured insight hero: heading, copy, imagery and CTA(s) to the featured article.
functional: Heading + copy + imagery promoting a featured insight with CTA(s).
acceptance: Renders heading/imagery; CTA links to the featured insight.

cmp-results-hero.name: Results Hero (stats)
cmp-results-hero.complexityReason: Hero with headline and prominent KPI stats (e.g. $5 ROAS, 3.4%).
functional: Heading + supporting copy + a row of prominent KPI stats with footnotes.
acceptance: Renders heading and the stat figures.

cmp-solutions-hero.name: Solutions Hero
cmp-solutions-hero.complexityReason: Section hero for the solutions overview: heading, copy, imagery.
functional: Heading + copy + imagery introducing solutions.
acceptance: Renders heading and imagery.

cmp-solutions-detail-hero.name: Solution Detail Hero
cmp-solutions-detail-hero.complexityReason: Large solution-detail hero with H1, sub-sections (H2/H3) and many links/buttons (43 observed) — likely tabbed/anchored navigation into solution offerings.
functional: H1 + supporting copy.
Multiple solution offerings presented as sub-sections with links/CTAs.
May include tab or anchor navigation between offerings.
Rich media/imagery per offering.
acceptance: Renders the H1 and all solution offerings.
Navigation/links between offerings work.
Each CTA navigates correctly.
verify: Check whether offerings switch via tabs/anchors; interact to confirm.
Confirm CTA/link targets.

cmp-footer-teaser.name: Footer Teaser (CTA band)
cmp-footer-teaser.complexityReason: Pre-footer CTA band: heading, supporting copy, imagery and CTA button(s) driving conversion.
functional: Heading + copy + CTA button(s) in a full-width band above the footer.
acceptance: Renders heading and CTA(s); each CTA navigates to its target (e.g. contact).
verify: Confirm CTA links resolve.

cmp-callout.name: Callout (results band)
cmp-callout.complexityReason: Promotional callout band with heading, stat/claim and CTA link(s); a background variation exists.
functional: Heading + claim/stat copy + CTA link(s).
Background variation for emphasis.
acceptance: Renders heading and CTA(s); CTAs navigate correctly.
Background variation renders with its themed background.
verify: Confirm CTA links; note background variation.

cmp-featured-button.name: Featured Button / Resource Band
cmp-featured-button.complexityReason: Resource band with heading and prominent button(s) linking to an external portal/resource.
functional: Heading + description + prominent CTA button(s) to a resource/portal (often external).
acceptance: Renders heading and button(s); button navigates to the resource.
verify: Confirm button target (may be external).

cmp-image-with-text.name: Image with Text
cmp-image-with-text.complexityReason: Alternating media + text blocks; observed as a horizontal scroller/slider of feature panels.
functional: Pairs media with heading + copy in alternating layout.
May scroll/slide through multiple feature panels.
acceptance: Each panel renders media + heading + copy.
If a slider, prev/next or scroll advances panels.
verify: Confirm whether panels are static or a slider; interact if a slider.

cmp-feature-text.name: Feature Text (reveal)
cmp-feature-text.complexityReason: Large statement text with a 'reveal' animation variation and an optional CTA.
functional: Prominent statement/heading with a scroll-triggered reveal animation.
Optional CTA button.
acceptance: Text renders and the reveal animation triggers on scroll.
CTA (if present) navigates correctly.
verify: Scroll to trigger the reveal; confirm animation and CTA.

cmp-text-circle-images.name: Text + Circle Images (category stats)
cmp-text-circle-images.complexityReason: Category stat tiles (e.g. Beauty, Health, Household) with figures and circular imagery.
functional: Displays category tiles with a figure/stat, label and circular image.
acceptance: Renders each category tile with its stat and image.

cmp-flip-circles.name: Flip Circles (interactive audience)
cmp-flip-circles.complexityReason: Interactive flip-card circles revealing audience segments on hover/click; requires flip interaction + responsive behavior.
functional: Grid of circular cards representing audience segments.
Hovering/clicking a circle flips it to reveal detail.
acceptance: Circles render in a grid.
Hover/click flips a circle to show its back content.
Works on touch (tap) as well as hover.
verify: Hover and click a circle; confirm the flip reveals back content on desktop and touch.

cmp-featured-circles.name: Featured Circles (differentiators)
cmp-featured-circles.complexityReason: Static set of circular feature callouts (Your Customer / Your Choices) with headings and copy.
functional: Circular feature callouts each with a heading and supporting copy.
acceptance: Renders each circle with heading and copy.

cmp-featured-solutions.name: Featured Solutions (tabbed)
cmp-featured-solutions.complexityReason: Grouped solution showcase (In-store / Onsite & Owned / Offsite) with many links (12 buttons) — tab/segment switching between solution groups.
functional: Presents solution groups (In-store, Onsite & Owned, Offsite Digital).
Tabs/segments switch the visible solution group.
Each solution links to its detail page.
acceptance: All solution groups are reachable via the tabs/segments.
Switching a tab shows that group's solutions.
Each solution link navigates to its detail page.
verify: Click each tab/segment; confirm the content switches.
Confirm solution links resolve.

cmp-instore-solution-cards.name: Solution Cards (grouped)
cmp-instore-solution-cards.complexityReason: Grouped solution cards (e.g. wagDSP, DSP & SSP, CTV) with headings and descriptions under a section header.
functional: Section header + a grid of solution cards each with heading and description.
acceptance: Renders each solution card with heading and description.
Any card links navigate correctly.
verify: Confirm card links (if any) resolve.

cmp-icon-carousel.name: Icon Carousel (steps)
cmp-icon-carousel.complexityReason: Horizontal step/process carousel with icons, step headings and copy, plus a CTA; prev/next navigation.
functional: Horizontal carousel of steps (icon + heading + copy).
Prev/next controls advance steps.
A CTA button (e.g. Let's go).
acceptance: Steps render in sequence.
Prev/next advances the visible step(s).
The CTA navigates correctly.
verify: Click prev/next; confirm steps advance.
Confirm the CTA target.

cmp-card-carousel.name: Card Carousel
cmp-card-carousel.complexityReason: Horizontal carousel of content cards (heading + copy + CTA) with prev/next navigation.
functional: Horizontal carousel of cards (heading + copy + CTA).
Prev/next controls advance cards.
Each card CTA links out.
acceptance: Cards render; prev/next advances them.
Each CTA navigates correctly.
verify: Click prev/next; confirm advance; confirm CTA targets.

cmp-solution-carousel.name: Solution Carousel
cmp-solution-carousel.complexityReason: Horizontal carousel of solution channels (in-store/onsite/offsite) with imagery, headings and links; prev/next navigation.
functional: Carousel of solution channels each with imagery, heading, copy and link.
Prev/next controls advance slides.
acceptance: Slides render; prev/next advances them.
Each slide link navigates to its solution detail.
verify: Click prev/next; confirm advance; confirm links resolve.

cmp-people-slider.name: People / Audience Slider
cmp-people-slider.complexityReason: Large multi-panel slider of audience/feature stories with imagery, headings, copy and many CTAs; prev/next navigation.
functional: Slider of feature/audience panels (imagery + heading + copy + CTA).
Prev/next controls advance panels.
acceptance: Panels render; prev/next advances them.
Each CTA navigates correctly.
verify: Click prev/next; confirm advance; confirm CTA targets.

cmp-logo-slider.name: Logo Slider (partners)
cmp-logo-slider.complexityReason: Auto-scrolling/marquee band of partner logos under a heading.
functional: Heading + a row/marquee of partner logos.
Logos may auto-scroll or be swipeable.
acceptance: Logos render under the heading.
If auto-scrolling, the marquee animates; if swipeable, drag/prev-next works.
verify: Observe whether logos auto-scroll or require interaction.

cmp-case-studies-cards.name: Case Study Cards
cmp-case-studies-cards.complexityReason: Grid of case-study cards (category eyebrow + title + KPI + CTA) linking to case-study pages.
functional: Section header + grid of case-study cards (category, title, KPI/result, CTA).
Each card links to its case-study page.
acceptance: Renders each case-study card with its result.
Each card navigates to its case study.
verify: Confirm card links resolve.

cmp-results-cards.name: Results Cards (load more)
cmp-results-cards.complexityReason: Grid of result/case-study cards with a 'Load more' control that reveals additional cards.
functional: Grid of result cards (title + KPI + CTA).
'Load more' reveals additional cards.
acceptance: Initial cards render.
Clicking 'Load more' appends more cards.
Each card links to its detail.
verify: Click 'Load more'; confirm additional cards append.

cmp-case-studies.name: Case Study Article
cmp-case-studies.complexityReason: Case-study detail body: eyebrow + H2 + narrative copy + imagery.
functional: Eyebrow + heading + long-form case-study narrative with imagery.
acceptance: Renders the case-study heading and body content.

cmp-related-reads.name: Related Reads
cmp-related-reads.complexityReason: Related-content promo at the foot of a case study/insight linking to another read.
functional: Heading + related article promo (image + title) linking to another read.
acceptance: Renders the related item and links to it.
verify: Confirm the related link resolves.

cmp-testimonial.name: Testimonial
cmp-testimonial.complexityReason: Quote/testimonial with attribution; may rotate multiple quotes.
functional: Displays a quote with attribution (name/role).
May cycle through multiple testimonials.
acceptance: Renders the quote and attribution.
If rotating, quotes cycle.
verify: Observe whether testimonials rotate or are static.

cmp-about-people.name: About People (team)
functional: Heading + a grid of team-member cards (photo, name, role, blurb).
acceptance: Renders each team member with photo, name, role and blurb.

cmp-featured-people.name: Featured Persona
cmp-featured-people.complexityReason: Rich persona narrative (e.g. 'Meet Maria') with many images and stacked sub-sections telling a customer story.
functional: Narrative persona feature: heading + sequential sub-sections with imagery describing a customer profile.
acceptance: Renders the persona narrative sections and imagery in order.
verify: Confirm the persona sections render (check for scroll animation).

cmp-insight-search.name: Insights Filter + Search
cmp-insight-search.complexityReason: Filterable/searchable insights list: type/topic filters, text search, apply/clear controls, results grid — client-side filtering (or query endpoint) with multiple states.
functional: Filter controls (Types, Topics, etc.) + a text search field.
Apply filters / Clear all controls.
Results grid updates to match filters/search.
Result cards link to insight articles.
acceptance: Selecting filters and applying narrows the results.
Text search narrows results.
Clear all resets filters and restores the full list.
Each result links to its insight.
verify: Apply a filter and confirm the results narrow.
Type a query and confirm results update.
Click Clear all and confirm reset.
Determine whether filtering is client-side or hits an endpoint.

cmp-header.name: Header / Navigation
cmp-header.complexityReason: Off-canvas / multi-level navigation with active-state tracking, integrated search toggle, and responsive desktop-bar vs mobile-drawer. Usually a shared Experience Fragment.
functional: Logo links to the homepage.
Primary navigation exposes top-level categories; sub-navigation reveals child links.
Active category is highlighted.
Search entry point toggles the search field.
Responsive: persistent bar on desktop, drawer/hamburger on mobile.
acceptance: Navigation renders the full category tree on every page.
Selecting a top-level category reveals or navigates to its children.
The category matching the current page is marked active.
On mobile the menu button opens/closes the drawer.
verify: Click the menu/hamburger button; confirm drawer opens.
Click a top-level item; confirm sub-items reveal or navigation occurs.
Confirm active-state highlight on the current section.

cmp-search.name: Predictive Search
cmp-search.complexityReason: AJAX predictive/typeahead search with min-length gating, loading/empty/results states and keyboard a11y; on EDS must be rebuilt against an index (query-index.json).
functional: Search field (role=search).
Minimum query length gates the request (check data-cmp-min-length).
Returns a capped number of results (check data-cmp-results-size).
AJAX request to a search endpoint returning JSON results.
Loading indicator + clear button.
Each result links to a page.
acceptance: Below the min length, no request fires and no results show.
At/above min length, matching results render as a typeahead list.
Clicking a result navigates to that page.
Clear empties the field and closes results.
verify: Inspect .cmp-search for data-cmp-min-length / data-cmp-results-size and the form action.
Hit the search JSON endpoint with a sample query and confirm the response shape.

cmp-footer.name: Footer
cmp-footer.complexityReason: Large multi-column link structure + social + legal + disclaimer, content-driven; usually a shared Experience Fragment.
functional: Logo linking home.
Social profile links (external).
Category link columns mirroring nav.
Legal/privacy links.
Disclaimer + copyright.
acceptance: Footer renders columns, social, legal and copyright on every page.
Social icons open the correct external profiles.
verify: Confirm footer is present on multiple templates and links resolve.

cmp-hero-carousel.name: Hero Carousel
cmp-hero-carousel.complexityReason: Auto-rotating multi-slide carousel with dot/arrow nav, per-slide media + CTA, pause/resume.
functional: Auto-advances through slides.
Dot/arrow navigation jumps to a slide.
Each slide: media + headline + CTA link.
acceptance: On load the hero auto-rotates.
Selecting a dot shows that slide.
Each slide CTA navigates correctly.
verify: Load page, observe whether the active-slide indicator advances without interaction.
Click a dot/arrow and confirm the slide changes.

cmp-trending-articles.name: Trending Articles
cmp-trending-articles.complexityReason: Curated lead item + secondary list; content-driven.
functional: Heading + lead item + list of secondary links with titles/descriptions.
acceptance: Lists lead + secondary articles; each links to its article.
verify: Confirm the trending list renders and links resolve.

cmp-card.name: Article Card
cmp-card.complexityReason: Core reusable listing unit with multiple visual variations; drives listings, related content and carousels.
functional: Card is clickable to its target.
Shows image, category eyebrow, title, meta (read-time/byline/date) per variation.
Video variation overlays play icon + duration.
acceptance: Each card navigates to its target when clicked.
Category eyebrow links to the category.
Cards reflow responsively.
verify: Confirm card click navigates; check variation classes (small/medium/hero/video).

cmp-card-container-hero.name: Category Hero Card Container
cmp-card-container-hero.complexityReason: Featured cluster: one hero card + supporting cards atop category hubs.
functional: Presents featured articles as a hero card plus supporting cards.
acceptance: Hero container shows the featured article prominently with supporting cards linking out.
verify: Confirm the featured cluster renders atop the hub.

cmp-slick-carousel.name: Content Carousel
cmp-slick-carousel.complexityReason: Horizontal scroller with prev/next, disabled bound states, optional 'see all', responsive item counts.
functional: Horizontal carousel of cards with Previous/Next.
Previous disabled at start, Next disabled at end.
Optional 'see all' link.
acceptance: At the first position Previous is disabled.
Next advances items; at the end Next is disabled.
'see all' navigates to the full listing.
verify: Click Next/Previous; confirm items scroll and bound states toggle.

cmp-paginate.name: Article Listing + Pagination
cmp-paginate.complexityReason: Client-side paginated grid: numbered pages, prev/next bound states, jump-to-page, no reload; data-driven from a category index.
functional: Renders the category grid in pages.
Numbered page buttons; Previous disabled on page 1, Next on last page.
Jump-to-page control.
Verify whether pagination is client-side (no reload) or server-side.
acceptance: On page 1 Previous is disabled.
Clicking a page shows that page's items.
On the last page Next is disabled.
verify: Click page 2; confirm whether the URL changes / page reloads or content swaps in place.
Confirm prev/next disabled states at bounds.

cmp-promo-blocks.name: Promo Blocks
cmp-promo-blocks.complexityReason: Static promotional image tiles with title + link.
functional: Promotional tiles (image + title) linking to featured content.
acceptance: Each promo tile links to its target and shows image + title.
verify: Confirm tiles link correctly.

cmp-explore.name: Explore (category tiles)
cmp-explore.complexityReason: Grid of category tiles (image + name), sometimes with live article counts.
functional: Grid of category tiles; may show a live article count per tile.
acceptance: Each tile links to its category; counts (if present) are shown.
verify: Confirm tiles link to categories; note any live counts.

cmp-explore-more.name: Explore More (related)
cmp-explore-more.complexityReason: Row of related-item cards at the foot of detail pages; reuses the Card block.
functional: Row of related items as cards below the main content.
acceptance: Related-item row shows cards linking to their targets.
verify: Confirm related row renders and links resolve.

cmp-breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
cmp-breadcrumb.complexityReason: Hierarchical trail derived from page path.
functional: Shows Home > ... > current; ancestors are links.
acceptance: Breadcrumb reflects the page path; ancestors navigate.
verify: Confirm the trail matches the URL hierarchy.

cmp-jump-to-section.name: Jump to Section
cmp-jump-to-section.complexityReason: Dropdown TOC expanding to in-page anchor links; requires generating/binding anchors.
functional: Button toggles a dropdown of section links.
Selecting an item scrolls to the in-page anchor.
acceptance: Clicking toggles the list open/closed.
Selecting a section scrolls to the matching anchor.
verify: Click the button; confirm it expands and anchors point to in-page IDs.

cmp-embed.name: Video / Media Embed
cmp-embed.complexityReason: Multiple providers (Scene7/Dynamic Media, YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify) with poster/lazy-load; may include transcript pairing and commerce links.
functional: Embeds a video/podcast player from the detected provider.
May add a related products/links block and a transcript section.
acceptance: The embedded player loads and is playable.
Any related links navigate correctly; transcript text is shown where present.
verify: Identify the provider(s) via iframe src / player script.
Confirm the player renders.

cmp-watch-videos.name: Watch Videos (gallery)
cmp-watch-videos.complexityReason: Gallery of video cards each launching a player; combines a card grid with the video embed lifecycle.
functional: Gallery of video cards; selecting one plays the video.
acceptance: Each video card shows a thumbnail + duration and plays when selected.
verify: Click a video card; confirm the player launches.

cmp-episode-container.name: Episode Container (series)
cmp-episode-container.complexityReason: Series episode navigation: current-episode player, more-episodes carousel with S:E badges, transcript link.
functional: Shows the current episode player.
'More episodes' reveals an episode carousel with prev/next.
'Read transcript' links to the paired transcript page.
acceptance: More-episodes reveals the carousel; prev/next scroll episodes.
Each thumbnail navigates to that episode.
Transcript link opens the paired page.
verify: Open 'More episodes'; scroll the carousel; follow the transcript link.

cmp-hero.name: Section Hero
functional: Hero banner (image + title) introducing a section.
acceptance: The section hero shows image and title.
verify: Confirm banner renders.

cmp-scroll-to-top-button.name: Scroll to Top
cmp-scroll-to-top-button.complexityReason: Floating button appearing after scroll; returns to top.
functional: Button appears after scrolling; clicking smooth-scrolls to top.
acceptance: After scrolling the button is visible; clicking returns to top.
verify: Scroll down; confirm the button appears and works.

cmp-background-container.name: Background Container
cmp-background-container.complexityReason: Section wrapper applying a themed background; maps to EDS section metadata.
functional: Wraps a section to apply a themed background.
acceptance: Wrapped sections render with the specified background.
verify: Confirm background variations render.

cmp-social-media.name: Social Media Links
cmp-social-media.complexityReason: Static row of social icon links (usually in the footer XF).
functional: Row of social icon links opening brand profiles.
acceptance: Each social icon links to the correct external profile.
verify: Confirm social links resolve.

cmp-teaser.name: Editor's Pick / Featured Teaser
cmp-teaser.complexityReason: Teaser promoting a single curated item: media + eyebrow + title + byline.
functional: Promotes curated item(s) with media, eyebrow, title, byline and link.
acceptance: The teaser shows the curated item with media and links to it.
verify: Confirm teaser renders and links resolve.

cmp-series-list.name: Series List / Teaser
cmp-series-list.complexityReason: Landing structure listing series + teaser cards.
functional: Presents series as a list and/or teaser cards linking to each.
acceptance: Each series entry links to its landing; teaser shows image + title.
verify: Confirm series list renders and links resolve.

cmp-text.name: Rich Text
cmp-text.complexityReason: Rich-text body (paragraphs, lists, inline links); maps to EDS default content.
functional: Renders formatted rich-text content (paragraphs, lists, links).
acceptance: Rich text renders with correct formatting and working inline links.

cmp-title.name: Title
cmp-title.complexityReason: Heading component; maps to default content.
functional: Renders a heading at the configured level.
acceptance: Heading renders with correct level and text.

cmp-image.name: Image
cmp-image.complexityReason: Responsive image; maps to EDS optimized picture.
functional: Renders a responsive image with alt text.
acceptance: Image renders responsively with alt text.

cmp-button.name: Button / CTA
cmp-button.complexityReason: Link styled as a button; maps to EDS button autoblocking.
functional: Renders a CTA link styled as a button.
acceptance: Button navigates to its target.

cmp-separator.name: Separator
functional: Renders a divider between content.
acceptance: Separator renders between sections.
